# Skill

Validate Robot Files

## Purpose

Check Robot tests before and after browser execution.

## Inspect

- Test files
- Resource imports
- Robot log
- Screenshots
- Allure results

## Check

- Robot Framework installation
- SeleniumLibrary installation
- Browser and target URL
- Workbook data
- Test and report status

## Process

1. Run a dry run first.
2. Run the selected test suites.
3. Review the first failed keyword.
4. Generate the Allure report.
5. Record pass, fail, or skipped status.

## Output

- Commands used
- Test results
- First failure
- Report location
- Missing dependency
